description: Expose provider lifecycle, evaluation quality and failure outcomes, junk-leak withholding, circuit state and quorum, index-age reasons, resolver-cache telemetry, and report-only registry hygiene through generic Search Hub contracts.

requirements.title: Honest provider signals
requirements.description: Provider transport failure is distinct from graded emptiness; eval cases expose error outcomes and graded counts; lifecycle and quality gates are descriptor-driven; federation status names reachability, circuit, index-age, quality exclusions, and model availability; metrics expose resolver-cache and registry-hygiene evidence.

validation.notes: Focused Search Hub eval, routing, health, validation, metrics, registry, resolver-cache, demotion, recovery, lifecycle, and junk-leak tests pass without requiring the live substrate.
Healthy-substrate baseline, full active-provider suite coverage, and dense-to-hybrid before/after evidence remain pending while Ollama/reranker are GPU-degraded and shared test-genie work is active.
